The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 643930d71faeb8ba), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n, m ≥ 1, let Ω ⊂ Cn be an open set containing 0, and let f = (f1, . . . , fm) : Ω → Cm be holomorphic. Suppose that, for some integer k ≥ 1, (i) f−1(0) = {0} and |f(z)| = O(|z|k) as z → 0; (ii) for every 0 < s < 1, the set {z ∈ Ω : |f(z)|2 ≤ s} is a compact subset of Ω. Set τ = |f|2 , V = {z ∈ Ω : τ(z) < 1}, ω = ddc (|z|2 + τ). For every 0 < c < πk, there is a smooth symplectic embedding B2n (c), ω0  −→ (V, ω).
